Event 7 distance 23.15 km reflective loss 0.26 dB reflectance -53.0. That's far end A-ODF. From B, A-ODF at 22.51 km. Distance 23.15 km close.

So main anomaly is near-end reflective loss 2.93 dB at B. OTDR from A also shows reflective loss 2.95 dB at far end (23.152 km). That's same event seen from both ends.
